dimensions.assessment: Affects energy companies, landowners, and residents in eastern Montana and areas impacted by federal land resource management.
dimensions.evidence: opens certain land administered by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) in eastern Montana to coal leasing

dimensions.assessment: Reverses a resource management plan that previously made zero acres available for coal leasing, directly impacting potential commercial coal development.
dimensions.evidence: nullifies the rule issued by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) relating to the Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan

dimensions.assessment: Potential economic and leasing revenue effects from opening public lands to coal development are implied, but no specific dollar figures are provided.
dimensions.evidence: opens certain land administered by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) in eastern Montana to coal leasing

dimensions.assessment: Disapproves a single agency rule under the Congressional Review Act, rendering the specific resource management plan amendment null and void.
dimensions.evidence: Congress disapproves the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management... and such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: Permanently invalidates the specified rule and alters the legal status of coal leasing availability on the affected federal acreage.
dimensions.evidence: such rule shall have no force or effect

missing_information: Estimated financial return or leasing revenue from opening the land to coal
importance_detail.rationale: The joint resolution nullifies a specific Bureau of Land Management rule, reopening over 1.7 million acres in eastern Montana to coal leasing.
